Dove l’AI non arriva: Marco Vita al TEDx: Where AI can’t reach: Marco Vita at TEDxAncona. — LAIF Blog
From the TEDx Talks YouTube channel.
L’IA può replicare la gioia di risolvere: Can AI replicate the joy of solving a problem on your own? We talked about it at TEDx Ancona.
Il punto dell’intervento di Marco Vita:: The point of Marco Vita’s talk: AI can find solutions. But it feels nothing. It doesn’t know uncertainty, doubt, the spark that comes when we understand something by ourselves. And perhaps that is exactly where the answer lies: no, AI cannot replicate that joy.
Perché non è solo il risultato che conta: Because it isn’t only the result that matters. It’s the journey. It’s the effort, the intuition, the meaning we give to every step.
La tecnologia può affiancarci. Ma siamo: Technology can work alongside us. But we decide how to use it. So, will AI replace people? No. But it will replace those who cannot evolve.
